fact_previews: InSite is a News Sharing app designed to provide news and information first hand by users.
The aim of InSite is to remove bias and censorship in news reporting.
InSite allows users to control what they see and what gets reported on.
InSite features a location-based verification system that allows users to upvote or downvote posts.
Users can decide what news is most important to them through the upvote or downvote system.

fact_previews: Users can navigate to the location of an event and verify its truthfulness.
Users can navigate between videos categorized into two sections: Happening Near Me and Trending Worldwide.
The Happening Near Me tab shows the closest trending posts to the user, allowing them to scroll through videos sorted by proximity.
The Trending Worldwide tab displays posts with the most engagement and significance based on community consensus, sorted by view count and location.
On a post, users are presented with a full screen video that scales to the size of their device.

fact_previews: InSite allows users to share posts to other social media platforms or through text and email.
InSite features a Related Articles button that displays published articles relating to a story.
Users can add or vote on articles that they think relate to or are about the post.
Tags for the post are displayed, allowing users to tap on them and explore other posts with the same tags.
InSite uses a completely decentralized system that allows anybody, anywhere, to share news.
